hashConvention: SHA-256 uppercase hex of UTF-8 canonical JSON: ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'); exclude sharedAstronomyInputSnapshotHash.

calculation.ketuRule: KETU longitude is (TRUE_NODE_RAHU longitude + 180) mod 360; KETU speed equals true-node longitude speed.
calculation.eventOrdering: exactUtc ascending, then eventId ascending, inherited unchanged from P0.
